Summary: Ritik turns leadership priorities into operating systems that improve speed, visibility, and growth. His work combines cross-functional execution, analytics, revenue operations, and practical AI.

## About
I believe most problems inside a company are not talent problems. They are clarity problems. My job is to bring that clarity, shape it into a simple plan, and stay on the ground until the plan actually ships.
For the last few years I have worked between leadership and delivery. I take the goals a CEO cares about, translate them into systems, dashboards, and daily actions, and then push until the numbers move. I have done this across real estate, technology, and high volume operations.
I move fast, I use AI where it saves real money and time, and I measure everything. Give me a hard goal and I will build the path to reach it and own the result.

## Experience

### Flow Realty | Manager, Strategy (Sales & Marketing) | Apr 2026 to Present
Leads sales and marketing strategy across CRM, calling, bookings, AI, and web operations. Built a platform handling more than INR 2 crore in monthly bookings, saved INR 11 lakh+ in recurring costs, raised message delivery from 30% to 70% in two days, increased calls from 70 to 150+ daily through Ozonetel across 12 agents and 9 projects, led the Zoho migration, built a zero-recurring-cost DeepFilterNet3 application, and trained teams on Claude Skills, Cowork, and MCP.

### Rustomjee, Keystone Realtors | Executive Trainee, Strategy | Apr 2025 to Apr 2026
Supported CEO and MD priorities through more than 100 channel-partner NPS interviews, 10+ board presentations, 5+ KPI dashboards across four teams, operating-model documentation, risk assessments across 20+ micromarkets, and an AI voice bot handling 200+ daily calls. The work informed INR 1,100 crore in quarterly sales.
